title: Sports & Activities
description: Covers sports vocabulary, talking about sports you play or watch (I play football, I go swimming), health benefits of exercise, and activity schedules. For elementary learners interested in active lifestyle topics.

content.content: {"time":1700000701000,"blocks":[{"id":"aB1cD2eF3g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Let's learn the names of popular sports in English:"}},{"id":"hI4jK5lM6n","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Team sports (командные виды спорта):"}},{"id":"oP7qR8sT9u","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["football / soccer — футбол","basketball — баскетбол","volleyball — волейбол","hockey — хоккей","baseball — бейсбол","rugby — регби"]}},{"id":"vW0xY1zA2b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Individual sports (индивидуальные):"}},{"id":"cD3eF4gH5i","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["tennis — теннис","swimming — плавание","running / jogging — бег / пробежка","cycling — езда на велосипеде","gymnastics — гимнастика","boxing — бокс","skiing — катание на лыжах"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

topics.title: Module 2: Talking About Sports You Play

content.content: {"time":1700000703000,"blocks":[{"id":"eF5gH6iJ7k","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"In English, we use three different verbs to talk about doing sport. The verb depends on the type of sport:"}},{"id":"lM8nO9pQ0r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"PLAY — used with ball sports and competitive games:"}},{"id":"sT1uV2wX3y","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I play football / basketball / tennis / volleyball / chess."]}},{"id":"zA4bC5dE6f","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"GO — used with activities ending in -ing:"}},{"id":"gH7iJ8kL9m","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I go swimming / running / cycling / skiing / jogging."]}},{"id":"nO0pQ1rS2t","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"DO — used with martial arts, gymnastics, and individual activities:"}},{"id":"uV3wX4yZ5a","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I do gymnastics / boxing / yoga / karate / exercise."]}},{"id":"bC6dE7fG8h","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Tip: When in doubt, try to remember: play a game, go + -ing activity, do a discipline."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I play football. I go swimming. I do yoga. She plays tennis. He goes cycling.

content.instructions: Say how often you do sport

content.text: I [play] football [twice] a week, on Tuesday and Thursday. My friend [goes] running every [morning]. At weekends, we [do] yoga together. In winter, I [go] skiing in the mountains.

content.text: I am a big fan of football. I support the national team and watch every match on TV.
A: What is your [favourite] sport? B: I love football. I'm a big [fan]. A: Do you [play] or just watch? B: I prefer [watching] — I go to the [stadium] every month.

subtopics.title: 4.1 Why Sport Is Good for You

content.content: {"time":1700000707000,"blocks":[{"id":"qR7sT8uV9w","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Exercise is good for your health. Here is how to talk about the benefits:"}},{"id":"xY0zA1bC2d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Physical benefits (физическая польза):"}},{"id":"eF3gH4iJ5k","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Exercise keeps you fit. — Упражнения поддерживают форму.","It strengthens your muscles. — Укрепляет мышцы.","Sport improves your heart health. — Улучшает здоровье сердца.","It helps you lose weight. — Помогает похудеть.","You feel more energetic. — Чувствуешь себя энергичнее."]}},{"id":"lM6nO7pQ8r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Mental benefits (психическая польза):"}},{"id":"sT9uV0wX1y","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Exercise reduces stress. — Снижает стресс.","It improves your mood. — Улучшает настроение.","Sport helps you sleep better. — Помогает лучше спать."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Exercise keeps you fit and reduces stress. It also improves your mood and helps you sleep better.

content.content: {"time":1700000709000,"blocks":[{"id":"pQ0rS1tU2v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"We use the Present Simple for regular schedules and going to for future plans:"}},{"id":"wX3yZ4aB5c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Present Simple (regular routine):"}},{"id":"dE6fG7hI8j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I go to the gym every Monday.","She plays tennis on Fridays."]}},{"id":"kL9mN0oP1q","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Going to (future plan):"}},{"id":"rS2tU3vW4x","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I am going to play football this Saturday.","We are going to go cycling at the weekend."]}},{"id":"yZ5aB6cD7e","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Want to / Would like to (wishes):"}},{"id":"fG8hI9jK0l","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I want to try yoga. — Я хочу попробовать йогу.","I would like to learn to ski. — Я хотел бы научиться кататься на лыжах."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.targetPhrase: Would you like to go swimming today? I'd love to! What time?

content.text: Would you like to go swimming? That sounds great! Let's meet at the pool at 5 pm.
A: [Would] you like to go swimming today? B: That [sounds] great! What time? A: How [about] 5 pm? B: Perfect! Let's [meet] at the pool.
